notes: 9-page PDF. Capability table has five columns: Preview Non-thinking/Thinking (09-2025), Non-thinking/Thinking (06-17), and Gemini 2.0 Flash (header says Flash, not Flash-Lite). Seed id google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite maps to (06-17); Preview (09-2025) has no seed id so rawModelName is used. Safety table values are deltas vs Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite (increase = more violations for safety rows; increase = better for Tone/Instruction Following). Aider Polyglot Preview cells are dashes and were skipped. MRCR Thinking (06-17) 128k is printed as 30.6^. FACTS Grounding PDF extract wraps so Thinking/2.0 Flash numbers appear above Preview/Non-thinking numbers. No external testers named. FSF is inherited from 2.5 Pro Preview with no per-domain CCL breakdown.
